'''Master Jen''' is a servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]]. He is short, bullish and little older than [[Haesel]].

==Activities==
When Mat wants to see [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]], Jen takes him from Haesel to Mistress [[Carin]], two other servants in the Tarasin Palace.
